st.t: Talk to Ava in the west wing of Draynor Manor to begin the quest.
s: I would be happy to make your home a better place.

st.t: Talk to Malcolm at the farm west of the Ectofuntus.
Talk to Alice.
Talk to Malcolm again.
Talk to Alice again.
Talk to the Old crone just east of the Slayer Tower twice.
s: I'm here about the farmers east of here.

st.t: Give the Crone-made amulet to Malcolm.
s: Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.

st.t: Talk to Malcolm again to watch a cutscene.
Buy two undead chickens from Malcolm. You can acquire ecto-tokens using the Ectofuntus to the east.
s: Could I buy those chickens now, then?

st.t: Give the two Undead chickens to Ava.
Talk to the witch twice. She is in a room near Ava, in the north-west corner of Draynor Manor.
Go to the iron mine in Rimmington northeast of the house portal.
In the centre of the mine, walk one square north so your character faces north. Tap the compass so the camera faces north too, then use the hammer on the Selected iron.
Give the Bar magnet to Ava.
Try to chop an undead tree outside Draynor manor.
Talk to Turael in Burthorpe twice, giving him the Mithril axe and Holy symbol.
s: Hello, I'm here about those trees again.

st.t: Try to chop an undead tree outside Draynor manor with the Blessed axe until you receive undead twigs.
Give the Undead twigs to Ava.
Talk to Ava to receive the research notes.
Translate the research notes.
Give Ava the translated research notes.
Combine Hard leather and Polished buttons with the pattern.
Give Ava the container.
